name: conversation-atlas
description: A live side pane that maps a long Claude Code session: goal, current path, possible detours, decisions, open questions, checkpoints, working files and what to resume next. It observes on its own and asks before changing your intent.

observer.title: Observer
observer.description: claude and engine: Claude reports topic shifts, decisions and questions through a small tool (a few tokens per turn) besides the free engine events. engine only: files, activity, tests, commits and your own wording only; no tool, no system-prompt rules.
